name: Encrypted Sigil
summary: In Shadowglen, a coded summons brings new night elf rogues to their trainer. Conservator Ilthalaine carries the message for Frahun Shadewhisper, who warns that peace across Kalimdor remains fragile.

sections.title: A Message in the Shadows
sections.body: While young night elves study nature's balance under Conservator Ilthalaine, those drawn to stealth receive a quieter summons. A runner brings the Encrypted Sigil from Frahun Shadewhisper, Shadowglen's rogue mentor. Its ciphers are meant for initiates of the trade. They are to decipher the message and find Frahun near the roots of Aldrassil to begin instruction.

sections.title: Watching the Horizon
sections.body: Frahun's message warns that peace across Kalimdor remains uncertain. The Third War has ended, but the truce between the Alliance and the emerging Horde is fragile. So rogue scouts and informers in Shadowglen are urged to sharpen their eyes and ears early. They watch for threats and covert provocations that could renew war across the borders.

faq.answer: Frahun Shadewhisper sends a coded token to new rogues in Shadowglen. Its message directs them to find him beneath Aldrassil for training.

faq.q: Who hands the sigil to young night elves?
faq.answer: Conservator Ilthalaine delivers the sigil for Frahun after an initiate shows basic skill managing the local wildlife around Shadowglen's boughs.

faq.q: Where can Frahun Shadewhisper be found?
faq.answer: Frahun Shadewhisper can be found beneath the Great Tree Aldrassil in Shadowglen. He is ready to instruct newly arrived night elf rogues.

faq.q: Why are rogues needed in peaceful Teldrassil?
aliases: why do night elves need rogues
faq.answer: Rogues are needed because the truce with outside factions is fragile. Scouts and informers watch for subterfuge, including Horde movements and threats within the boughs.

faq.q: What happens after presenting the sigil to Frahun?
faq.answer: After you present the sigil, Frahun accepts the cipher and acknowledges your readiness. As you gain experience, you can return for lessons in combat techniques, weapon handling, and stealth.

faq.q: Does the Horde actively threaten Shadowglen directly?
faq.answer: The Horde does not openly assault secluded Teldrassil. Yet whispers that Horde agents are sowing distrust across Kalimdor keep kaldorei sentries and operatives alert.

angles.text: As a rogue, you join the kaldorei scouts, assassins, and informers who guard Teldrassil from unseen adversaries.
As a night elf, you share Aldrassil's watch over Kalimdor's shifting borders and defend its newly planted boughs.
As an Alliance member, you hear Shadowglen's trainers warn that treaties between factions are fragile. Intelligence work helps prevent Horde incursions.
